title: Extensionality of the obtainable-set count for the Kuratowski 14-set
intent: Show that exactly 14 distinct sets are obtainable from `fourteenSet` by closure and complement. The proof rewrites the set-cardinality goal into a multiset-cardinality statement using `card_theFourteen` and `nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet`, then closes the remaining set equality pointwise with `ext` from the characterization `mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable`.

children.name: card_theFourteen
children.note: The whole lemma is a computation: `theFourteen s` is a literal 14-element multiset, so its `.card` normalises to 14 by `rfl`. A leaf that closes with no argument. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: the multiset theFourteen s has cardinality 14

children.name: nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet
children.note: Splits no-duplicates into (i) nodup of `theClosedSix` (given by `nodup_theClosedSix_fourteenSet`) and (ii) disjointness of `theClosedSix` from `theOpenSix`, discharged by the pointwise fact that no closed-six set is univ or empty. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: theFourteen fourteenSet has no duplicates

children.name: mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable
children.statement:
theorem mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable {s t : Set X} :
    t ∈ theFourteen s ↔ IsObtainable s t
children.note: Forward direction by repeated case analysis of multiset membership into the 14 literals, closing each by the `IsObtainable` constructors; reverse direction by `IsObtainable.mem_theFourteen`. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: t is in theFourteen s iff t is obtainable from s

applicability.goal_shape: A cardinality equality `{t | P s t}.ncard = N` where `P s t` is an inductively defined reachability predicate and the counting multiset is already known; the proof rewrites `ncard` to a multiset/finset `card`, then needs a set equality `{t | P s t} = theFourteen s` closed pointwise.
applicability.use_when: the set being counted has an explicit finite description (a multiset) and a characterization lemma `t ∈ theFourteen s ↔ P s t`; then `ext` plus one `simp` with that characterization closes the remaining equality.
applicability.avoid_when: the pointwise membership equivalence is not yet a lemma (then `ext` leaves a genuine two-direction proof); the cardinality fact is not `rfl` and needs its own argument; the set equality is not the final step but feeds further structure.

claims.claim: The main proof is 4 lines of glue over 3 direct lemmas, whose child sites span 1, 7 and 13 lines; the no-duplicates child closes through a chain of 4 project lemmas down to `sum_map_theClosedSix_add_compl`.

claims.claim: No `sorry`, `admit` or `axiom` closes the parent or its child `nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet` in Archive/Examples/Kuratowski.lean lines 228-241.

The same characterization `mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable` closes the companion 'at most 14' theorem `ncard_isObtainable_le_fourteen` by `simp [Set.ext_iff, mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable]` (lines 107-109 of Archive/Kuratowski.lean).

metrics.how_counted: card_theFourteen closes by rfl alone; nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet and mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable close by their own named sub-lemmas and case analysis

consequences: The move leaves the value 14 and the no-duplicates obligation to two named lemmas (`card_theFourteen`, `nodup_theFourteen_fourteenSet`) that are reused from elsewhere in the file, and concentrates the whole 'obtainable = theFourteen' correspondence into one iff lemma. The `ext` step is cheap only because that iff exists: without `mem_theFourteen_iff_isObtainable` the pointwise goal would be a real two-direction induction on `IsObtainable`, not a `simp`.
